note: Wooded campground climbing the hill behind W Milan Rd (NH-110) in Berlin, with direct OHRV trail access to Jericho Mountain State Park and the Ride the Wilds network. Primitive RV sites with water delivery and septic pumping, plus tent sites. --Claude
summary: Operator (RoverPass-hosted) site + RoverPass API: primitive RV and tent sites $35/night ($210 week, $700 month), no hookups (water delivery and septic pumping), open May 7 to Nov 1 per the engine; RoverPass bookable but for 2027 it sells only the 9 tent sites online. Google 4.6 (50). Price passes; OHV-base and seasonal questions flagged. Pin ~480 m off at the entrance.
flags: OHV (reviewer call, not a drop): the operator markets itself as an ATV base with trails from the campground - home page 'visitors have direct trail access to Jericho Mountain State Park, Ride the Wilds trail network and The Yamaha Connector trail! There is no reason to trailer your machine anywhere after you arrive!'; amenity list 'Off-Roading/ATV'; rules 'if you are on the ATV trails please obey all NH OHRV rules'. It also sells ordinary RV and tent nights ('Whether its for a day or two, we hope to see you soon!').

LONG-STAY / NIGHTLY SHARE (unmeasured): the rates page posts daily $35, weekly $210 and a monthly $700 rate with a month-by-month table, and the amenity list includes 'Extended Stay'. The RoverPass engine (bookable, CRS) offered NO RV site type on any 2027 test date (May, June, July, September; Tuesdays and Saturdays) - only 'Tent Sites - Primitive', 9 available. Esri (fall imagery) shows roughly 45-50 RVs spread along the hillside roads with the season ending, which may be seasonal units left in place. No discouraging wording toward nightly guests found. Read as an ATV-trail park whose RV sites may be mostly seasonal; the reviewer should weigh it with the OHV flag.

PRIVATE GATE: passes - cheapest RV night $35 (primitive, the only RV type), undated operator rates page read 2026-11-23; same in every season.
